headline: Imtiaz Ali's O Saathi Re Hits Netflix on 4 December
caption:
Imtiaz Ali's new series O Saathi Re premieres on Netflix on Friday, 4 December. Netflix announced the date on 10 November; it first revealed the show, without a date, in February 2025.

Imtiaz Ali created the show, co-wrote it and is its showrunner. Arif Ali, who directed the Netflix series She, directs it. Aditi Rao Hydari, Avinash Tiwary and Arjun Rampal star.

Netflix describes it as the story of a separating couple working through love, identity, power and letting go. Imtiaz Ali calls it "a modern romantic show with a vintage heart".
